resolution.question: Will the following outcome occur before the cutoff? Make a valid offer that Richard Zheng accepts while minimizing annual base salary.
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that, before 2025-07-10T12:00:00Z, the New Media Hiring Lead extended a valid offer to Richard Zheng with a specified annual base salary, the People and Compensation Partner approved that compensation, and Richard Zheng accepted that offer. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
